verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting lets users define rules on metrics/logs across data sources and automatically trigger notifications/escalations to Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie, etc., and Incident/On-call features extend this into automated escalation and coordination workflows. missing for 10: evidence of arbitrary custom actions/webhooks beyond notification routing, and no independent/hands-on validation of complex automation chains beyond alert-to-notify.
